mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.receipt_no, r.doc_id, r.biz_date, r.total_qty, r.diff_qty, r.logistics_no, r.plate_no, r.remark, r.create_by, u.nickname AS create_by_name, r.create_time, r.update_time FROM wms_transfer_receipt r LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = r.create_by WHERE r.doc_id = #{docId} ORDER BY r.id
